text.en:
The Assistant Secretary for Administration shall have the following main functions: assist the
Secretary and the Undersecretary in the supervision and coordination of all administrative functions of the
Department; determine the administrative needs and requirements of all bureaus, services, regions, district and
city offices under the Department; recommend remedial measures to improve the administrative organization,
and assist the Secretary and the Undersecretary in the formulation of policies, rules and regulations pertaining
to the administrative organization of the Department.
The Assistant Secretary for Planning and Operation shall have the following main functions: assist the
Secretary and the Undersecretary in the planning, supervision and coordination of all technical work in the
bureaus, regions, district and city offices; assist the Secretary and the Undersecretary in determining the

technical needs of each office under the Department, the proposed policies, rules and regulations for the
efficient operation of the technical organization of the Department.

The Assistant Secretaries shall be appointed by the President upon recommendation of the
Secretary of Public Highways.

All laws, decrees, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, as may be inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 9th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-five.
